posts.zh:
clippy-harness#plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。回形针助手回来了，这次它真的会干活：会对真实 agent 状态做出反应的办公助手宠物，任务完成时跳起来庆祝，回合失败时弹出经典的 "illegal operation" 对话框。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c36a9eb90db512cd1ca3.html
posts.en:
clippy-harness#plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Clippy is back and this time he can actually help. An office assistant pet that reacts to real agent state, jumps when the turn completes, and opens a classic "illegal operation" dialog when a turn fails.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c36a9eb90db512cd1ca3.html
